snippet.title: Learn Jingle Bells on Guitar with the Gibson App | Zoundio Play Along
snippet.description:
I play and learn guitar 
Jingle Bells Melody and Chords
With extremely fun 
Gibson App by Zoundio

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gibson-learn-play-guitar/id1116032929

Gibson app has pitch detection 
Learning system
Makes it easy and fun
To learn beginner 
And intermediate 
Guitar 

App will listen to
Your guitar with phone or IPad 
And help you 
Learn guitar 

There are many ways 
To use Gibson app
To learn guitar 

I connected my Stranberg Guitar
To IPad Pro
With IRig HD 2
IK Multimedia 

I Used the Bias FX 2 App
For IPad 
For Guitar Tone

I Screen recorded my
Performance 
As a video

I Edited video with
iMovie 

Questions?

You can Join two
Facebook groups 

Gibson App Fan Club
And 
MiamiChristine Guitar 

I am not affiliated with 
Gibson App

I am a fan of the app

I am a guitar hobbyist 

Finally have time to
Learn guitar 

We are living in
The golden age of
Guitar gear and 
Learning tools
